svg.text: Kimi K3 Enterprise Serving on GKE Blackwell
One multi-node serving replica · 2 x a4-highgpu-8g · 16x NVIDIA B200 HGX (2,880 GB HBM3e) · TP=16 / PP=1 / EP=16 · SGLang 0.5.16
GKE Deployment x2 — same cluster as serving
Primary Ingress & Control Fabric — standard gVNIC: API gateway traffic, Kubernetes control plane & health probes
Multi-Node Serving Replica 1 — a single Leader/Worker MPI world, TP=16 / PP=1 / EP=16 spanning BOTH nodes
Selectable engine: SGLang 0.5.16 (shipped default) | NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM (experimental, not benchmarked)
1,440 GB HBM3e per node · 180 GB / GPU
Node-local scratch: hicache L3 + DSPARK draft — both off by default
Intra-node NVLink 1.8 TB/s · 8 of the 16 TP ranks
~780 GB MXFP4 weight shard · ~443 GB KV / recurrent-state pool
weights read-only from the Tier 0 ROX volume
1,440 GB HBM3e per node · 180 GB / GPU
Node-local scratch: hicache L3 + DSPARK draft — both off by default
Intra-node NVLink 1.8 TB/s · 8 of the 16 TP ranks
~780 GB MXFP4 weight shard · ~443 GB KV / recurrent-state pool
weights read-only from the Tier 0 ROX volume
Each additional replica is a further
raises gpu_pool_max_nodes from 2 to 4 on its own
Each extra leader gets its own ClusterIP Service
as a second upstream under one model_name
Exercised at DP=2 — killing a replica leader:
2.38 s blackout, 0.06% errors; README has the caveats
Mandatory High-Bandwidth MoE Fabric — RoCEv2 GPUDirect RDMA · 8x multi-NIC subnets (rdma-0..7) · MTU 8896 · 3.2 Tbps per node
concurrent ReadOnlyMany mount into every serving pod
2,000 GB · XFS mounted ro, nouuid, norecovery
Warm pod ROX recovery measured 17 min 03 s — no weight transfer on restart
Tier 3 hydrates Tier 0 once. Tier 0 is
mounted straight into the serving pods.
Tier 2 NVMe is node-local scratch and is
a 512 GiB RAM-backed emptyDir, not Tier 2.
All three. The draft lives in GCS, so the pods
need a KSA that can read it.
dspark-draft-fetch rsyncs the 4.19 GiB draft from Tier 3 GCS into
/mnt/draft on the Tier 2 NVMe array — not the ROX volume, which is
read-only once hydrated — and copies in the base generation_config.json
What it buys — and the catch
2.00x - 3.82x aggregate throughput over the TP16 default, measured
on the harness's repeated-passage prompts (README Table 4).
Acceptance collapses from ~6.4 to ~2.2 accepted tokens per verify
step on non-repetitive text. Plan capacity from that column.
Shipped default — SGLANG_PARALLEL_PROFILE=tp16, mem-fraction-static 0.85, schedule-policy lpm, 131,072 ctx, engine-dispatched kernels, no speculative decoding.
